rationale: P identifies the braking behaviour that must be characterised to evaluate whether required maneuvers are omitted. SG-1 and FR-7 establish braking performance itself—not merely mechanisms supporting it—as the subject of evaluation. The obstacle-related scope is supported by FR-7 and H-1, including the stated pedestrian scenario. P does not incorporate sensing, computation, communication, internal control mechanisms, or their timing constraints.
determining_elements: “Vehicle/system braking response” directly addresses the behaviour required by SG-1 and FR-7.
“Whether braking is initiated and performed” characterises occurrence or omission of the required maneuver.
The scope limits evaluation to driving situations where collision avoidance may require braking, with the pedestrian encounter explicitly supported by H-1.
